name: native text-to-speech probe: screen on, off, app in background (COI-3466)

args: dumpsys webview | grep -i -E 'current webview|version' | head -4; settings get secure tts_default_synth; pm list packages | grep -i -E 'tts|speech'
am broadcast -a dev.coilyco.treehouse.PROBE_TTS -p dev.coilyco.treehouse --es mode file --es text 'Hello from the probe.'
ls -l /data/data/dev.coilyco.treehouse/cache/ 2>&1 | grep probe; run-as dev.coilyco.treehouse ls -l cache 2>&1 | grep probe

am broadcast -a dev.coilyco.treehouse.PROBE_TTS -p dev.coilyco.treehouse --es mode speak --es text 'The seat is answering. This sentence is long enough to still be playing when the audio service is read, so that a player shows as started.'
